there is a need for a clear monitoring and evaluation policy that is clearly defined and implemented.

the effectiveness of monitoring CDF projects in Likoni.
how the CDF is monitored and evaluated in Likoni Constitucency.
factors affecting the effectiveness of Monitoring and Evaluation of projects under the CDF in Likoni Constitucy.

effective monitoring and evaluation can be achieved through training and capacitating of those tasked with this responsibility, delineation of budgetary allocations, clear institutional framework, stakeholder participation and limiting of political interference.
